title: Convergence analysis of a numerical scheme for the Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes system with dynamical boundary condition and its application to moving contact line problem
summary: A finite difference numerical scheme is proposed and analyzed for the Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes system, combined with a dynamical boundary condition. Such a physical system has potential applications in the moving contact line problem. The boundary profile is governed by a lower-dimensional energy potential, coupled with a non-homogeneous boundary condition for the phase variable. In the numerical design, a convex-splitting approach is applied to the chemical potential in both bulk and surface levels, which leads to a highly coupled nonlinear system.
